title: quint-checktrace corpus gate manifest
description: The reviewed manifest consumed by the corpus gate. The document is an array of rows, one row per candidate main module, identified by (path, main). A file with several runnable mains carries one row for each main. A file with no runnable main carries a single exclusion row whose main is null. This schema validates shape only. The semantic refusals cannot be expressed here: two rows with the same (path, main), a row whose invariants array repeats a name, a corpus file with no row, and a row whose file is absent are all gate refusals. The schema also cannot check that every invariant of a recorded main carries a status, or that the statuses match the committed derivation records. Nor can it check that a main row with no invariant carries neither `max_steps` nor `seed`.

row.description: One manifest row. A row with a main names that main's invariants with a per-invariant status. A row without a main is an exclusion row and carries a row-level reason instead.

path.description: The specification path relative to the corpus tree root, the directory that contains the real, third-party and synthetic trees. The pattern refuses an absolute path and any leading or interior parent-directory segment; the gate refuses the same shapes with exit 2 at stage resolve, naming the row.

main.description: The main module name, the value supplied as --main during derivation. Null marks a file with no runnable main.

invariants.description: One entry per invariant of this main. A row with a main but no invariant carries an empty array and a row-level reason.

reason.description: The recorded reason a row is excluded: a library module, a file with no invariant, a file with no runnable main, or a Quint runtime error with its diagnostic code.

max_steps.description: The --max-steps value used to derive this row's traces. Required when the row's invariants array is non-empty. A main row with no invariant has no derivation, so it carries neither this field nor seed and gives a row-level reason instead; the schema does not express that absence, which is a semantic rule (R33).

seed.description: The --seed value used to derive this row's traces, recorded as text in decimal or hexadecimal form (for example 1 or 0x1). Required when the row's invariants array is non-empty, on the same rule as max_steps.

invariant.description: One invariant of a recorded main with its per-invariant status. A derive status means the invariant produced an admitted triple. An exclude status carries the recorded reason.

reason.description: The recorded reason for an exclusion, including the diagnostic code when the derivation ended in a runtime error. Required when status is exclude.
